instructions: Read macrohelp://guide for the control playbook. Check macrohelp_health and macrohelp_state before acting. Use macrohelp_schema for request fields and macrohelp_help for native Registry Hub syntax. no_replace is temporary configuration, not a dry run. Inspect state after errors/timeouts before retrying actions.

tools.name: macrohelp_skills
tools.description: User saved skills. No arguments lists names/references. name alone queries the first literal Summary line from rgd ist through the backend and returns an existing no_replace control request (does not execute it). name+rgd saves; name=remove (case-insensitive) and rgd=the saved name removes. The current Registry Hub file supplies the references. Mutations/query require an idle overlay.

tools.name: macrohelp_control
tools.description: Operate the overlay's native menus or patch supplied config fields. Each inputs string submits one field including Enter. no_replace makes config temporary, not execution. Continue partial dialogs with their run ID; inspect macrohelp_state for completion/errors. Read macrohelp_help for workflow syntax. Never blindly replay after a timeout.

tools.name: macrohelp_state
tools.description: Read configuration, current dialog, active run ID, busy status and last_run result/error. Read before acting or retrying. Does not return the live key-display feed.

tools.name: macrohelp_coords
tools.description: Read the exact physical-pixel x/y coordinates currently shown by the overlay. Does not move the pointer or start a run.

tools.name: macrohelp_board
tools.description: Read the current screen's existing grid labels, display text, printed integer cell centers and cell_size, even when hidden. Labels reset per screen and are not rescaled. Board codes resolve only in coordinate fields, never in literal text. Does not move the pointer or start a run.

tools.name: macrohelp_stop
tools.description: Stop all macros and cancel the active overlay control run through the existing stop-all path. Available while busy; cannot undo completed external actions.

tools.name: macrohelp_schema
tools.description: Read the running overlay's accepted request/config fields, menu names and button actions. Use to correct invalid requests; use macrohelp_help for Registry Hub brace syntax.

tools.name: macrohelp_health
tools.description: Check overlay readiness and connectivity to the separate Tasket/Omarsket execution backend.

tools.name: macrohelp_help
tools.description: Read the running overlay's own Registry Hub Help page: router keys, workflow tokens, variables, zones and shell usage. Read before writing scripts; grammar remains platform-native. Does not open a dialog or execute anything.

resources.name: User saved skills
resources.description: Saved display names and rgd references; empty by default.

resources.name: Macrohelp control playbook
resources.description: Menu workflow, temporary config, completion and safe error recovery.

resources.name: Registry Hub Help
resources.description: The running platform's native Registry Hub Help page.

resources.name: Overlay control schema
resources.description: The running overlay's request/config schema and menu inventory.

resources.name: Live board coordinates
resources.description: Current screen's grid labels and printed integer cell centers, independent of display toggles.

recovery.400: Read macrohelp_schema and macrohelp_help, inspect macrohelp_state, then correct the rejected fields or current dialog input. Do not replay actions that may already have run.
recovery.401: Check the client's local control key and port settings against the overlay. Do not print the key or retry with guessed credentials.
recovery.403: Check the client's loopback connection and local control settings. Do not bypass the access check.
recovery.404: Inspect macrohelp_state and last_run before replacing an expired run ID or starting another flow.
recovery.409: Inspect macrohelp_state. Continue only your own active run with its ID and unchanged no_replace setting; do not automatically stop other work.
recovery.413: Reduce the request below 1 MiB and 256 inputs. Read macrohelp_schema; use one executable flow per run.
recovery.503: Check the running overlay and its backend connection with macrohelp_health. Inspect macrohelp_state before retrying; a timed-out action may already have started.
recovery.default: Inspect macrohelp_state before retrying. Read macrohelp_schema and macrohelp_help; never blindly replay a macro after an uncertain response.

rpc_recovery: Send one JSON-RPC 2.0 object per line with a string or numeric id, a method string and object params. Initialize first. Use tools/list, resources/list and macrohelp_schema to correct the request; do not guess or automatically replay actions.
